Folks — quick SRE update and what I can bundle now: 

Available artifacts (can produce within 30–45 mins):
- Prefix/KV cache metrics (per-host, per-model) time-series for 08:00–10:30 PT
- Per-request traces sampled at 100% for the impacted route (includes request_id, route, model_id, latency_ms)
- Runtime token logs (redacted per policy) with index pointers — note these contain user-supplied content; we can provide salted hashes instead of raw tokens if required
- Server syslogs and GPU utilization for affected pool

Chain-of-custody plan:
1) Create a snapshot (greenline_debug_snapshot_20260730.tar.gz) on an access-controlled bucket with object versioning enabled.
2) Generate SHA-256 checksums for each top-level file and sign with our upload-key (sig: redwood-incident-20260730.sig).
3) Produce an export manifest (JSON) that lists files, sizes, and checksums.

Constraints/notes:
- Our standard PHI policy prevents direct export of raw user prompts without a legal hold; we can instead provide salted hashes and metadata.
- If Greenline requires raw payloads for forensics, Legal will need a written request and the customer must agree to the retention window and access controls.

I'll start the snapshot now and attach the manifest when ready.

—Jonas

Priya / Monica / Jordan — Legal here. Short answers and next steps: 

1) Written request: For any export containing PHI or user content, we need a written, authorized request from Greenline (signed by an executive or GC). The attached PR-4567 looks sufficient but we need a countersignature or an email from your GC.
2) Redaction: We can provide salted hashes of prompts and full metadata without payloads immediately. For raw payloads we require a legal hold and will perform redaction/segregation in a secure export environment. Expect extra 48–72 hours for full payload deliverables.
3) Chain-of-custody: Our plan (Jonas outlines) is acceptable — we'll add a legal cover note and a retention covenant specifying that Redwood will hold the snapshot for 90 days unless Greenline requests longer.

If Greenline confirms they want the raw payloads and signs the export request, SRE can start a sealed export and we'll provide notarized checksums. Otherwise, Jonas — proceed with salted-hash export and metadata.

—Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
